subject: Bridge Unable to Open - Fraser River
text:
Bridge Unable to Open - Fraser River
Demolition of the Pattullo Bridge will take place at 49 12.460N 122 53.670W.
The upstream and downstream draws will be closed to marine traffic during demolition from 0400 UTC 10 Oct to 1400 UTC 12 Oct.
The domestic navigational channel will remain open for transit during demolition. 
Contact FRPD on VHF channel 69 for instructions 90 minutes prior to transit.
